{{Quote|Major Shenar thought our forces were enough. It's not Master Porter's fault.|An Imperial soldier|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Shenar''' was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Shenar assigned a number of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to protect the [[Outreach Bureau]]'s [[Project Eclipse]], but the numbers were insufficient and the project was nearly wiped out.
